content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: XQL(CLOUD-002 Microsoft Directory ReadWrite All Admin-Consent Scope Request) OR BIOC(CLOUD-002 Microsoft Application ReadWrite All In Same Grant Body) OR XQL(CLOUD-002 Microsoft Repeat Admin-Consent Persistence Attempt) GROUPED BY user, client_id, source_ip WITHIN 300s
rules.name: Microsoft Admin-Consent OAuth Abuse Cloud Persistence — Same Identity
